description:
With 7,000+ hotels across 100+ countries, IHG Hotels & Resorts delivers true hospitality for every kind of traveler. From memorable luxury stays to dependable comfort, IHG helps you find the right hotel, wherever your journey takes you.

Discover iconic brands like InterContinental, Kimpton, Crowne Plaza, Hotel Indigo, Holiday Inn, and more, each offering a distinctive stay experience, united by a shared commitment to true hospitality. Whether you’re planning a business trip, city getaway, or seaside escape, IHG makes it easy to find a stay that fits your travel needs.

Plan your next getaway by simply describing your ideal stay in the IHG app with ChatGPT.

Try searches like:
"Find a hotel tonight nearby for less than $200"
"Show me hotels for the perfect romantic getaway"
"Where's the best hotel near the Mercedes-Benz Stadium?"

Easily explore our global portfolio, compare options, and plan your stay with ease. When you’re ready to book, complete your reservation securely on IHG.com.

Also, with IHG One Rewards, every stay is more rewarding. Members unlock exclusive rates, earn redeem points at thousands of hotels worldwide, and enjoy flexible booking benefits.

Let’s get started on your stay!
